# Population Pharmacokinetics of Intravenous Acyclovir in Oncologic Pediatric Patients (Maximova N, Nistico D, Luci G, Simeone R, Piscianz E, Segat L, Barbi E, Di Paolo A, Front Pharmacol 2022)

Reference: doi:10.3389/fphar.2022.865871 (Front Pharmacol 2022;13:865871; Table 2).

**Model type: parametric population pharmacokinetic model** (nonlinear mixed-effects, NONMEM 7.4, estimation method not reported). Suitable for simulation and MAP Bayesian estimation. Caution: the published covariate equation is ambiguous and was reconstructed from the post hoc estimates and the simulations of the authors (see Notes).

## Notes

- Study: prospective single-centre study (Trieste, 2011-2020), 120 children (73 boys, 47 girls) with haematological malignancies receiving IV aciclovir for prophylaxis (n = 94) or treatment (n = 26) during allogeneic HSCT or high-intensity chemotherapy, under therapeutic drug monitoring; 374 plasma concentrations (pairs of Cmax and Cmin on 1 to 3 occasions, LC-MS/MS). Mean (SD) and median age 8.6 (5.0) and 9.5 years, weight 32.4 (19.1) and 27.8 kg, height 128.2 (30.0) and 131.5 cm, SCR 0.361 (0.206) and 0.320 mg/dL, eGFR 228.1 (79.7) and 209.4 mL/min/1.73 m2 (Table 1). Intravenous only.
- Dose: `amt` in mg of aciclovir, 1-h infusion every 6-8 h (`rate = amt / 1`). Samples were drawn 10 min before the dose (Cmin) and 30 min after the end of infusion (Cmax).
- Structure: one-compartment model, first-order elimination.
- Covariates: eGFR (power) and weight (allometric) on CL, as two additive terms (see below), weight on V. eGFR is the Schwartz 1976 formula (the only reference given), eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.55 x HT (cm) / SCR (mg/dL), computed in the model with SCR in umol/L divided by 88.4; it is captured.
- **Ambiguity:** the article cites only the original Schwartz 1976 equation and does not report the k constants used by age or sex. **Choice:** k = 0.55 (Schwartz 1976, children and adolescent girls) for all patients; with the median height and SCR it gives 226 mL/min/1.73 m2, close to the median eGFR of Table 1 (209.4).
- **Ambiguity:** the footnote of Table 2 prints the final model as CL = [6.184 + (eGFR/209.4)^1.627 + (WGT/27.8)^0.75] (eta1 + IOV) and V = [18.942 + (WGT/27.8)^1] eta2, without stating which "+" signs stand for products. Three readings were tested by Monte Carlo simulation in the conditions of the authors (1,000 children per regimen, weight fixed to 27.8 kg, eGFR sampled from a normal distribution of mean 228.1 and SD 79.7 mL/min/1.73 m2, published IIV and IOV, 1-h infusion, steady state) and compared with Table 3 (post hoc means: CL 14.0 L/h, V 25.4 L, half-life 1.36 h, AUC 26.0 mg.h/L for a mean dose of 334 mg) and Table 6:
  - fully multiplicative, CL = 6.184 x (eGFR/209.4)^1.627 x (WT/27.8)^0.75 (typical CL 6.2 L/h): mean simulated CL 9.1 L/h and half-life 3.6 h; 10 mg/kg every 6 h (eGFR <= 250) gives Cmin > 0.56 mg/L in 89% (Table 6: 50.9%) and Cmax > 25 mg/L in 25% (Table 6: 1.0%);
  - fully additive, CL = 6.184 + (eGFR/209.4)^1.627 + (WT/27.8)^0.75 (typical CL 8.2 L/h): mean CL 9.4 L/h, half-life 2.2 h; Cmin > 0.56 mg/L in 74%;
  - multiplicative on the sum of the two covariate terms, CL = 6.184 x [(eGFR/209.4)^1.627 + (WT/27.8)^0.75] (typical CL 12.4 L/h), with V = 18.942 x (WT/27.8): mean CL 15.8 L/h, V 25.2 L, half-life 1.35 h, AUC 29.1 mg.h/L; 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 mg/kg every 6 h (eGFR <= 250) give Cmin > 0.56 mg/L in 52, 59, 64, 66 and 69% (Table 6: 50.9, 57.8, 62.5, 65.7, 67.9%), Cmin > 1.125 mg/L in 37, 46, 52, 56 and 59% (35.2, 45.1, 50.9, 54.6, 57.8%) and every 8 h Cmin > 0.56 mg/L in 33, 40, 44, 48 and 50% (31.2, 39.7, 44.4, 47.2, 50.1%); the simulated mean concentrations after 10.3 mg/kg every 6 h (1.5 h: 7.9 mg/L; 5.83 h: 1.1 mg/L) match the measured values (7.6 and 1.0 mg/L).
  **Choice:** CL = 6.184 x [(eGFR/209.4)^1.627 + (WT/27.8)^0.75] x exp(eta1 + IOV) and V = 18.942 x (WT/27.8) x exp(eta2) (the first "+" of each equation read as a product), the only reading that reproduces the post hoc estimates, the measured concentrations and Table 6. Remaining differences: for eGFR > 250 mL/min/1.73 m2, the simulated Cmin target attainment is lower than in Table 6 (10 mg/kg every 6 h, Cmin > 0.56 mg/L: 24% vs 37.8%), and the simulated Cmax > 25 mg/L (end of infusion) is slightly higher for eGFR <= 250 (20 mg/kg every 6 h: 41% vs 28.6%; 15% if Cmax is taken 30 min after the end of the infusion).
- Default covariates: medians of Table 1: WT 27.8 kg, HT 131.5 cm, SCR 28 umol/L (0.32 mg/dL).
- IIV (Table 2, CV%): CL 45.2%, V 56.7%, converted with omega^2 = ln(1 + CV^2): 0.1856 and 0.2768 (the text also reports 46.4%).
- IOV on CL: CV 20.0% (omega^2 0.0392), estimated over up to three monitoring occasions; implemented with two paired occasions (covariate OCC). IOV on V was not retained.
- **Ambiguity:** the residual error is a proportional model reported as "0.181" (SE 0.050) without stating whether it is a variance or an SD. **Choice:** variance 0.181 (CV 42.5%), the raw NONMEM sigma estimate (the IIV terms, unlike the residual error, are given as CV%). With an SD of 0.181 the variance would be 0.0328.
- Targets used by the authors: Cmin > 0.56 mg/L (HSV) or > 1.125 mg/L (VZV) and Cmax < 25 mg/L; augmented renal clearance defined as eGFR > 250 mL/min/1.73 m2.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(mrgsolve)
library(mapbayr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r model}
code <- '
[PROB]
Maximova et al. 2022 - intravenous aciclovir in oncologic children (HSCT or chemotherapy)
(120 children, 374 TDM samples, NONMEM 7.4). One-compartment model, first-order elimination.
Covariates: CL = TVCL x [(eGFR/209.4)^1.627 + (WT/27.8)^0.75] (Schwartz eGFR computed from HT and SCR), weight on V.
IIV on CL and V, IOV on CL (two occasions). Proportional residual error.

[SET] end = 24, delta = 0.1

[PARAM] @annotated
TVCL     : 6.184  : Clearance coefficient, CL = 12.37 L/h for eGFR 209.4 mL/min/1.73 m2 and 27.8 kg (L/h) (ambiguous, see Notes)
TH_GFR   : 1.627  : Exponent of eGFR on CL
EGFR_REF : 209.4  : Reference eGFR, median (mL/min/1.73 m2)
WT_REF   : 27.8   : Reference weight, median (kg)
TVV      : 18.942 : Volume of distribution for 27.8 kg (L)
SCHW_K   : 0.55   : Schwartz constant (ambiguous, see Notes)
ETA1     : 0      : IIV CL
ETA2     : 0      : IIV V
ETA3     : 0      : IOV CL, occasion 1
ETA4     : 0      : IOV CL, occasion 2

[PARAM] @annotated @covariates
WT  : 27.8  : Body weight (kg)
HT  : 131.5 : Height (cm)
SCR : 28    : Serum creatinine (umol/L)
OCC : 1     : Occasion (1 or 2)

[CMT] @annotated
CENT : Central compartment, aciclovir (mg) [ADM, OBS]

[MAIN]
double EGFR = SCHW_K * HT / (SCR / 88.4);
double IOVCL = (OCC == 2) ? (ETA4 + ETA(4)) : (ETA3 + ETA(3));
double CL = TVCL * (pow(EGFR / EGFR_REF, TH_GFR) + pow(WT / WT_REF, 0.75)) * exp(ETA1 + ETA(1) + IOVCL);
double V  = TVV * (WT / WT_REF) * exp(ETA2 + ETA(2));

[ODE]
dxdt_CENT = -CL / V * CENT;

[OMEGA] @annotated
ECL : 0.1856 : IIV CL (variance, CV 45.2%)
EV  : 0.2768 : IIV V (variance, CV 56.7%)

[OMEGA] @annotated
EOCC1 : 0.0392 : IOV CL occasion 1 (variance, CV 20.0%)
EOCC2 : 0.0392 : IOV CL occasion 2 (variance, CV 20.0%)

[SIGMA] @annotated
PROP : 0.181 : Proportional error (variance) (ambiguous, see Notes)
ADD  : 0     : Additive error (mg/L), not estimated

[TABLE]
double IPRED = CENT / V;
double DV = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2);
int i = 0;
while (DV < 0 && i < 100) { simeps(); DV = IPRED * (1 + EPS(1)) + EPS(2); ++i; }

[CAPTURE] @annotated
DV   : Aciclovir plasma concentration (mg/L)
EGFR : Estimated GFR, Schwartz (mL/min/1.73 m2)
CL   : Individual clearance (L/h)
V    : Individual volume of distribution (L)
'
mod <- mcode("ACV_Maximova", code)
```

```{r simulation}
# Typical 27.8 kg child (131.5 cm) receiving 10 or 20 mg/kg every 6 h (1-h infusion), steady state,
# eGFR about 209 (SCR 30.6 umol/L) and 300 mL/min/1.73 m2 (SCR 21.3 umol/L, augmented renal clearance)
data <- expand.grid(dose = c(10, 20), SCR = c(30.6, 21.3)) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number(), time = 0, evid = 1, cmt = 1, amt = dose * 27.8, rate = amt / 1, ii = 6, addl = 15)

out <- mod %>%
  zero_re() %>%
  data_set(data) %>%
  mrgsim(end = 96, delta = 0.05, carry_out = "dose") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(time >= 90) %>%
  mutate(time = time - 90, Regimen = paste0(dose, " mg/kg q6h, eGFR ", round(EGFR)))

# Article targets: Cmin > 0.56 / 1.125 mg/L, Cmax < 25 mg/L (Table 6: percentages with IIV)
out %>% group_by(Regimen) %>%
  summarise(CL = CL[1], V = V[1], Cmax = max(DV), Cmin = min(DV[time > 0]),
            AUCtau = sum(diff(time) * (head(DV, -1) + tail(DV, -1)) / 2))

ggplot(out, aes(time, DV, colour = Regimen)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.56, 1.125), linetype = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Time after dose (h)", y = "Aciclovir concentration (mg/L)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Maximova et al. 2022 - typical steady-state profiles, 1-h infusion every 6 h")
```
